product_one_liner.value: voize is an AI voice assistant for nurses and care providers that converts spoken observations into structured documentation in their existing care-record systems.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page explains facility-based licensing and invites visitors to request prices; numeric prices are not published.

named_customers.notes: Named customer references on the homepage; integration partners are excluded.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 140.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains nursing practice, customer, product and industry content; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public German help center includes multiple collections for nurses, managers, IT administrators, infrastructure and the voize platform.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior ML Engineer - NLP (m/f/d), Berlin, is listed with application buttons. The first-party Ashby posting could not be extracted, so this uses the readable job listing.

model_provider.value: voize's own proprietary, domain-specific AI models
model_provider.notes: The company describes in-house nursing-specific models with offline/on-device operation. Privacy references to third-party AI services alone were not treated as evidence that those services power the nursing product.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage explicitly claims DSGVO/GDPR compliance. This is a compliance claim, not an independently verified certification; no completed SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI DSS certification was established.

last_funding.notes: Announced November 17, 2025, led by Balderton Capital; no later round was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative in Berlin is listed with an Apply action and marked confirmed live within the last 24 hours.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index dates the new direct ORBIS U integration announcement September 30, 2026; the article explicitly introduces the new integration. This is within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive roster consists of the three founders, Linda Schuster and Philipp Wolf. Linda joined in January 2025 and Philipp in February 2025, before the window. Linda's June 2026 promotion from VP Operations to COO is an internal role change, not a company join or departure. No executive departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable SDR listing names HubSpot; the indexed first-party founding SDR posting names HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
